content_sections.heading: ESIC Faridabad Teaching Faculty Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad, has released a recruitment notification for engagement of Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts across 21 Broad Specialty Departments on a contract basis. The recruitment is being conducted through a walk-in interview, with a total of 49 vacancies printed in the notification: 05 Professor, 22 Associate Professor and 22 Assistant Professor posts. The notification includes details on department-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limit, application fee, salary, selection process and walk-in interview procedure. Candidates are advised to read the complete notification carefully before appearing for the interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 23 September 2026, with reporting between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad. Download ESIC Faridabad Teaching Faculty Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Official Website

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faridabad Teaching Faculty Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Vacancies are available in 21 Broad Specialty Departments. The table below reproduces the department-wise, category-wise distribution from the notification. A dash (-) means no vacancy is shown for that post in that department. The asterisk (*) indicates that the unreserved faculty is currently working against a reserved category post. The interview for such posts will be conducted only if candidates belonging to the respective reserved category appear. If no suitable or eligible candidate appears for interview, a candidate eligible for the lower post (that is, Assistant Professor for Associate Professor, or Associate Professor for Professor) will be permitted to be interviewed against the higher post. If such a candidate is selected, they will be appointed to the lower post with suitable down gradation as per eligibility and the recommendation of the selection board. Please verify the vacancy count: the printed totals are 5 (Professor), 22 (Associate Professor) and 22 (Assistant Professor), which make 49. However, adding the individual Associate Professor entries in the department table gives 23 (10 marked with an asterisk), not 22 (9 marked with an asterisk). The Professor and Assistant Professor columns match their printed totals. Candidates should confirm the correct figure with the official notification or the Dean's office.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Contract
content_sections.text: Contract period: 1 year (extendable up to 3 years). Service can be terminated at any time in public interest. Resignation requires one-month notice or one-month salary in lieu. No entitlement to service benefits (PF, pension, gratuity, etc.). Hostel/quarters subject to availability. Attendance mandatory via biometric system. No private practice allowed.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faridabad Teaching Faculty Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on academic credentials and interview performance. Results will be posted on www.esic.gov.in. The offer of appointment will be sent via email. Joining is as per the instructions in the appointment letter. The notification does not mention a written test. Only verified candidates will be allowed for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Faridabad Teaching Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview to be held on 23.09.2026 by ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad to engage Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor in Broad Specialty Departments on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The totals row shows 49 posts: 5 Professor, 22 Associate Professor and 22 Assistant Professor. The individual Associate Professor entries add up to 23, so please confirm the exact number with the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify a last date to apply. The walk-in interview is on 23.09.2026, with reporting between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification?
faq.answer: Qualification is as per the latest NMC guidelines, and the NMC notification dated 30/06/2025 on "Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulations 2025" applies.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 69 years as on the date of interview, and tenure is up to a maximum of 70 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹500 for the "Others" category, payable by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.1", payable at Faridabad. The fee is Nil for SC/ST/ESIC Employees, Female Candidates, servicemen and PwD.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: No online application is mentioned. Candidates must submit an offline application, attached with the advertisement, along with self-attested copies of documents. A separate application is needed for each post.
